objects.name: Bitget Confirms Third-Party Zero-Day Behind $387.5 Million Cryptocurrency Theft
objects.description: Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget on Wednesday confirmed that attackers who stole $387.5 million last week exploited a zero-day flaw in third-party security products, citing ongoing investigation findings from SlowMist.
